sloka: सुमालिनो वसोश्चैव समरेष्वनिवर्तिनोः ।ततस्तस्य महाबाणैर्वसुना सुमहात्मना ।निहतः पन्नगरथः क्षणेन विनिपातितः ।। ७.२७.४५ ॥
transliteration: sumālino vasoścaiva samareṣvanivartinoḥ ।tatastasya mahābāṇairvasunā sumahātmanā ।nihataḥ pannagarathaḥ kṣaṇena vinipātitaḥ ।। 7.27.45 ॥

translations.english: Then, in a moment, the chariot of Sumali, who, along with Vasu, did not retreat in battles, was struck down and overthrown by the great arrows of the very great-souled Vasu.
